firm_profile.name: Karani & Nyaga Advocates
firm_profile.headquarters: Riverside Green Suites, 4th Floor, Riverside Drive, Nairobi, Kenya
practice_areas: Tax Appeals & Special Tribunals (BPRT, RRT, TAT)

schedule_1_conveyancing.title: Schedule 1 — Conveyancing: Sales, Purchases, Mortgages & Charges

scale_brackets.description: 2% of consideration value up to KES 5,000,000 (Min KES 35,000)

schedule_2_leases.title: Schedule 2 — Leases & Tenancies at a Rack Rent

schedule_5_chattels_and_advisory.title: Schedule 5 — General Advisory, Securities & Hourly Rates

schedule_6_high_court.title: Schedule 6 — High Court & Commercial Litigation
schedule_6_high_court.governing_law: Legal Notice No. 35 of 2014 & Kenya Civil Procedure Act

instruction_fee_curve.description: 1% on all claim amounts exceeding KES 20,000,000

rules.defendant_scale: 80% to 100% of Plaintiff's instruction fee depending on whether defence or counter-claim is filed
rules.getting_up_fee: One-third (33.33%) of the calculated instruction fee. Applicable whenever a substantive Defence is filed.

schedule_7_magistrate.title: Schedule 7 — Subordinate & Magistrates Courts (Cap 21)
schedule_7_magistrate.rule: Scales proportionally to 60-70% of High Court Schedule 6 tariffs for lower pecuniary jurisdictions.

schedule_8_court_of_appeal.title: Schedule 8 — Court of Appeal Civil & Criminal Practice
schedule_8_court_of_appeal.rule: Calculated as the equivalent High Court Schedule 6 fee plus a statutory one-third (33.33%) appellate surcharge.

schedule_9_supreme_court.title: Schedule 9 — Supreme Court of Kenya Petitions
schedule_9_supreme_court.rule: Discretionary based on public importance, complexity, and constitutional value. Minimum baseline KES 500,000.

schedule_11_tribunals.title: Schedule 11 — Special Tribunals (BPRT, RRT, TAT, Energy, Co-operative)
schedule_11_tribunals.rule: 75% of Subordinate Court or High Court rates based on claim amount.

party_and_party.definition: Costs awarded to the successful party payable by the losing party, taxed strictly on the ARO scale by the Taxing Master under Section 68 of the Civil Procedure Act.
taxing_master_items: Item 6: Disbursements (Filing fees, CTS receipt, Process server)
Item 7: VAT (16% on professional fees only)

advocate_and_client.definition: All fees and disbursements payable by a client to their retained advocate, including retainer fees and advisory outside statutory court awards.
advocate_and_client.statutory_demand_section_48: An advocate cannot initiate recovery proceedings without delivering a signed bill of costs and waiting for 30 days statutory notice period under Section 48 of the Advocates Act.
